info.title: OnTech Store API
info.description: Stock, customers and orders for the OnTech store. Call POST /api/auth/login, then click Authorize and paste the token.

post.summary: Signs in with username and password and returns a bearer token for the other endpoints.

get.summary: The signed-in user, with their current permissions.

delete.summary: Deletes an empty category, or disables it if it has items (so order history stays intact).

get.summary: Customers for pickers and the customers list. Search matches customer number, company name, phone, tax number or contact.

delete.summary: Disables the customer; their orders stay in the log.

post.summary:
Adds many customers at once (the Import button on the Customers page). Rows with no company name,
or whose number is already taken, are skipped and reported; everything else is saved in one go.

get.summary: Numbers for the home page: stock totals, low-stock warnings and today's activity.

parameters.name: utcOffsetMinutes
parameters.description: The PC's offset from UTC, so "today" means the local day (e.g. 180 for UTC+3).

get.summary: Items with their available quantities. Filter by category for the New Order screen.

put.summary: Edits item details. Quantity is changed only by orders and stock-in vouchers.

delete.summary: Disables the item so it can't be ordered; history is kept.

get.summary:
The item card: every movement of this item, oldest first, with who supplied or took it and the balance after it.
With a period, also the balance just before it and the customers who took the most within it.

post.summary:
Creates an order and takes the quantities out of stock in one transaction.
Returns 409 with a "shortages" list if any item doesn't have enough stock; in that case nothing is taken.

get.summary: The orders log, with search, filters, sorting and paging.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: Free text: matches order number, issue voucher number, receipt number, customer name/tax number, item name/code, notes.

parameters.name: ReceiptNumber
parameters.description: Partial match on the receipt number.

parameters.name: IssueVoucherNumber
parameters.description: Partial match on the issue voucher number.

get.summary: Looks up an order by its receipt number (exact match).

post.summary: Cancels an order and puts its quantities back in stock. The order stays in the log as Cancelled.
Records stock received from a supplier and adds the quantities, in one transaction.

get.summary: The stock-in log, newest first, with search, filters and paging.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: Free text: matches stock-in number, voucher number, supplier invoice, supplier name/tax number, item name/code, notes.

post.summary: Cancels a stock-in entered by mistake and takes its quantities back out. It stays in the log as Cancelled.

get.summary: Suppliers for pickers and the suppliers list. Search matches supplier number, company name, phone, tax number or contact.

delete.summary: Disables the supplier; their stock-in vouchers stay in the log.
Disables the user. Users are never hard-deleted because orders reference them.

code.description: Digits only, unique across all items. Leave empty to get the next one (category code + 3 digits, e.g. 01007).

lowStockThreshold.description: Show a warning when stock falls to or below this number (0 = no warning).

issueVoucherNumber.description: The warehouse issue voucher number (إذن صرف). Required on every order and unique.

receiptNumber.description: Required when OnTech.Store.Contracts.CreateOrderRequest.WithReceipt is true; must be unique.

voucherNumber.description: The warehouse receipt voucher number (إذن إضافة). Required and unique.

supplierInvoiceNumber.description: The supplier's invoice or delivery note number, if there is one.

CreateStockInRequest.description: Stock received from a supplier. This and orders are the only ways quantities change.

username.description: What the user types to sign in: letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore. Not case-sensitive.

mustChangePassword.description: Ask the user to pick their own password on first login.

ImportCustomersRequest.description: Bulk-adds customers, e.g. from the old Excel sheet. Rows whose number already exists are skipped, so the same file can be imported twice safely.

messages.description: One line per skipped row, e.g. "Row 12: number 7 already exists".

from.description: The period shown, as asked for (null = from the first movement / up to now).

openingBalance.description:
Quantity at the start of the card: just before the period, or the item's opening stock (the store sheet it was loaded from)
when there is no start date. Opening stock is shown here, never as a movement line.

openingDate.description: The date OnTech.Store.Contracts.ItemCardDto.OpeningBalance is for (the period start, or the opening stock's date). Null when the item had none.

closingBalance.description: Quantity in the store at the end of the period.

totalIn.description: In and out within the period.

topCustomers.description: Customers who took the most of this item in the period, net of cancelled orders, most first (top 5).

ItemCardDto.description: An item's card (كارت الصنف): every movement in and out, oldest first, with the balance after each one.

in.description: Units that came in (0 when the movement took stock out).

out.description: Units that went out (0 when the movement brought stock in).

balance.description: Quantity in the store right after this movement.

documentNumber.description: The order or stock-in number, e.g. ORD-000012 or IN-000003.

voucherNumber.description: Issue voucher number for an order, receipt voucher number for a stock-in.

invoiceNumber.description: Customer receipt number for an order, supplier invoice number for a stock-in.

partyName.description: The customer who took the stock or the supplier who sent it.

issueVoucherNumber.description: Empty only for orders saved before the voucher number was required.

Permission.description:
What a user is allowed to do. Stored as a bit mask, so a user can hold any combination.
Admins implicitly have every permission.

code.description: Digits only. Leave empty to get the next free code (01, 02, ...) on create, or to keep the current one on edit.

customerNumber.description: Leave empty on create to get the next free number.

supplierNumber.description: Leave empty on create to get the next free number.

change.description: Positive for stock in, negative for stock out.

stockInCount.description: Stock-in vouchers from this supplier (not counting cancelled ones).

username.description: What the user types to sign in: letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore. Not case-sensitive.
